propositions: All in-tree structured-output consumers must route exclusively through the single PydanticAIRunner facade with one bounded Agent run per output mode, eliminating bespoke retry machinery and temporary compatibility delegation.

The output-retry allowance N is computed once from structured_retry_limit and seeds both the Agent retries={"output":N} parameter and the constructed UsageLimits request-limit addend, ensuring the request budget cannot trip before the output-retry counter.
Setting structured_retry_limit=0 must yield zero output-repair retries (single-shot Agent attempt) and preserve the batch-abstain fail-safe in overlap/judge.py and contracts.py.
A well-formed first response must trigger exactly one outer agent.run_sync call; only the bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade is permitted to invoke two, never a third.
Provider fallback eligibility, tool surfaces, timeout/transport limits, provenance, and serialized verdict shapes must remain unchanged from baseline behavior.
